No hardware backend was configured and no hardware was run; this package is model-authored and unreviewed. Facts cite the clone at 32e5bd1a1e516bf4caedcb31f1a8ee366f2efebc and G4 passes; the driver declares no Limit of its own, the action bound is derived from Box(low=-1.0, high=1.0) at humanoid_env.py:129-131. The fake is exercised by the gate and by seven repository cases in test_driver.py.
